firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently avoided a conflict starts. The campaign rules also allow choosing the starter randomly.
clarifications: Give that person the starting-player token. They begin the adventurer phase, with turns continuing clockwise.
When another round begins, pass the token to the right: the preceding round's last player starts next.
This answer covers the campaign's basic opening rules in the publisher's eleven-page excerpt. Follow additional scenario instructions; the separate Skirmish mode is not covered.

internalEvidence: Complete publisher-hosted or publisher-linked PDF retrieved (the Dawn file is explicitly a shortened campaign excerpt); relevant setup, opening-turn, variant and edition pages read and visually inspected. Reviewed PDF pages: 2, 3, 6, 8, 9, 11. The complete public PDF is an eleven-page opening excerpt, not the full campaign. Setup step 12 explicitly permits a random alternative. Pages 8–9 confirm the token holder actually takes the opening turn; page 11 passes the token counterclockwise for later rounds. Page 3 identifies ©2018 and BGG identity 221669. The publisher FAQ/errata at https://snowdaledesign.fi/dawn-of-peacemakers-faq/ was also read on 2026-09-23; its listed corrections do not replace these opening rules. Cached FAQ: dawn-faq.html.
